description: Processed numeric arrays derived from data/raw/. Generated by data/processed/generate_processed.py.

weight_matrix_er6.npy.description: Symmetric 6x6 adjacency-weight matrix for the official ER6 benchmark. W[i,j] = edge weight if edge (i,j) exists, 0 otherwise.

edge_list_er6.npy.description: Edge list [[u, v, w], ...] in canonical (u<v) order for ER6.

cut_values_er6.npy.description: Cut value C(x) for all 64 basis states of ER6. Index k = sum_i x_i * 2^i (Qiskit little-endian). This is the diagonal of the QAOA cost Hamiltonian.

cut_values_g6.npy.description: Cut value C(x) for all 64 basis states of the team auxiliary graph G6. Index k = sum_i x_i * 2^i (Qiskit little-endian).
